title: Augmented comparison into a pushed injective complex
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let J be its Zariski topology [def-sc-zariski-site], and let K be its small étale topology [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let i:X.Opens→X.Etale be continuous, with sheafification for abelian groups on both sites. Write L=i⁻¹ and G=i_* for the adjoint abelian sheaf functors [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and assume L additive and preserving finite limits. For an abelian étale sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], an injective resolution I of F and an injective resolution R of GF [def-sp-injective-resolutions], there exists a cochain map b:R→GI such that ι_R⁰ b⁰=G(ι_I⁰). No quasi-isomorphism condition on the pushed complex GI is assumed.

proof.text: The exact inverse image L preserves monomorphisms. The adjunction L ⊣ G therefore makes G preserve injective objects (Mathlib Functor.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_adjunction_of_preservesMonomorphisms). Each (GI)^n is injective.

Extend G(ι_I⁰) along the monic ι_R⁰ using Injective.factorThru. The composite with d_GI⁰ vanishes on ι_R⁰. R.exact₀.descToInjective extends it to b¹. At each subsequent degree, the preceding chain-map square and d²=0 make bⁿ⁺¹ d_GIⁿ⁺¹ vanish on d_Rⁿ. R.exact_succ.descToInjective supplies the next component. CochainComplex.mkHom assembles the squares; its zero component has the required augmentation.

proof_origin.note: Separate chain construction from identification with the canonical cohomology map; chain construction implemented in Lean.

mathlib_searches.query: Extend a morphism from an object into a complex of injectives to a chain map from an injective resolution
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib InjectiveResolution.desc uses two resolutions; factorThru, exact₀, exact_succ and CochainComplex.mkHom give the required construction without exactness of the target.

Mathlib computes Ext by resolution cocycles. Existing section comparisons use global étale cohomology or only give a presheaf isomorphism; none gives this objectwise Zariski-to-étale formula for characterized fstar and arbitrary resolutions.

theorem zariski_etale_resolution_comparison_chain_map_exists
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (R : InjectiveResolution ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F))
    :
    ∃ b : R.cocomplex ⟶
      ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex,
      R.ι.f 0 ≫ b.f 0 = (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map (I.ι.f 0)
